repos.description: Prompt as Code | GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库，530+ 个案例逆向工程，20+ 套工业级模板，并提炼出Skills，持续更新中
repos.hook: This repository provides a structured template library for image generation prompts. It treats prompts as modular code that you can version and test.
repos.personalization: Helpful if you want to apply structured prompt optimization techniques to image generation workflows.

repos.description: Community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code. Read-only mirror — submit plugins at clau.de/plugin-directory-submission.
repos.hook: This repository is a community marketplace for Claude Code plugins. Plugins are add-on tools that give the AI coding agent new capabilities and terminal commands.
repos.personalization: Directly relevant for evaluating third-party extensions and tool-calling patterns in Claude Code.

repos.description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
repos.hook: This tool generates interactive architecture and sequence diagrams. It outputs standalone HTML files with smooth animations and clean visual exports.
repos.personalization: Useful for generating clean system architecture diagrams for your fullstack side projects.

repos.hook: This project offers an automated installer for Arch Linux. It configures a modern desktop environment and developer tools with minimal manual setup.

repos.description: Apache Maka (Incubating) is a local-first AI agent workspace. Model messages, tool calls, tool results, permission decisions, and termination events are recorded as an append-only log.
repos.hook: This project is a local-first workspace for AI agents. It stores all model prompts, tool executions, and user permissions in an immutable log.
repos.personalization: Valuable for auditing agent behavior and evaluating tool-use decisions in a local development environment.

repos.description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Smart routing, automatic failover, encrypted keys. Personal experimentation only.
repos.hook: This proxy server routes requests to multiple free AI model providers through one unified endpoint. An endpoint is a web address that receives software requests. It includes automatic failover if a provider goes offline.
repos.personalization: Great for running low-cost prompt evaluations across many models without managing separate API accounts.

repos.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
repos.hook: This project automates job application workflows using Claude Code. It evaluates job postings, tailors resumes, and creates interview practice questions on your local computer.
repos.personalization: A practical example of using Claude Code to automate complex, multi-step tasks locally.

repos.description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
repos.hook: This repository is the official directory of plugins maintained by Anthropic. It contains verified tools and integrations for Claude Code.
repos.personalization: An essential reference for tracking official plugin standards as you evaluate Claude Code against other tools.

repos.description: ⚡️A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry.
repos.hook: This application is a lightweight, open-source driver for Logitech mice and keyboards. It runs locally without user accounts or background telemetry.

repos.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
repos.hook: This repository teaches practical AI engineering concepts using step-by-step code tutorials. It focuses on building and shipping real systems rather than studying academic theory.
repos.personalization: Directly matches your focus on hands-on applied AI engineering and system implementation.

repos.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
repos.hook: This repository defines the official plugin specification for the Cursor code editor. It includes sample plugins that extend the editor's AI features.
repos.personalization: Useful for comparing Cursor's extension model directly with Claude Code's plugin ecosystem.

repos.description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 190,000+ scientists worldwide. 165 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
repos.hook: This library provides specialized tools and database connectors for AI agents in scientific research. It helps agents query chemistry, biology, and clinical data sources.

repos.description: ConardLi's open-source Skills collection, featuring web design, knowledge retrieval, image generation, and more.
repos.hook: This repository contains a collection of reusable skills for AI agents. These skills help agents build web user interfaces, search documents, and create images.
repos.personalization: Provides practical agent skills you can plug into your fullstack web development workflows.

repos.description: GoogleTest - Google Testing and Mocking Framework
repos.hook: This repository contains Google's testing and mocking framework for C++ programs. It helps developers write automated unit tests to verify code quality.

repos.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and OpenCode and more for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)
repos.hook: This tool lets you run terminal coding agents using free model endpoints. It provides a simple setup to test agents without paying API fees.
repos.personalization: Helpful for testing terminal-based coding agents during side project development.

repos.description: Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom — Get an immersive, multi-agent learning experience in just one click
repos.hook: This platform simulates an interactive classroom using multiple AI agents. The agents act as instructors and students to discuss educational topics together.

repos.description: Drop in a screenshot and convert it to clean code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue)
repos.hook: This application converts design screenshots into frontend code. It supports popular web technologies such as HTML, Tailwind CSS, React, and Vue.
repos.personalization: Speeds up UI prototyping when building frontend interfaces for your fullstack apps.

repos.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
repos.hook: This project is OpenAI's lightweight coding agent that runs directly in your terminal. It inspects your repository, modifies source files, and executes commands.
repos.personalization: A key tool to benchmark when you evaluate terminal AI coding assistants against Claude Code.

repos.description: Your Personal AI super intelligence. A brain that builds a local-first memory of your life, a fantastic orchestrator of agent fleets and workflows, and a deep researcher.
repos.hook: This software is a local personal assistant that builds a long-term memory of your work. It coordinates multiple AI agents to perform research and manage workflows.
